crossRefs.keyword: twenty shekels. i.e., 3£. sterling. ten shekels. i.e., 1£.10s. sterling

translations.web: If the person is from five years old to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
translations.bsb: And if the person is from five to twenty years of age, then your valuation for the male shall be twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
translations.kjv: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
translations.asv: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
